title: Sunrise Spread
description: Sunrise Spread is a lightweight Minecraft mod that adds cozy breakfast foods like pancakes, waffles, and toast to your world. Simple to craft and vanilla-friendly, it’s perfect for builders, roleplayers, and food mod fans looking to start their day right.
body:
A lightweight Minecraft mod that brings breakfast to your blocky world.

Add a warm, satisfying touch to your survival experience with one simple item: the pancake. Crafted with care and cooked in a furnace, this custom food blends seamlessly into vanilla gameplay while offering a delicious twist.


🍳 Features

New Item: Pancake – A golden, stackable treat you can craft and cook with ease

Simple Furnace Cooking – No fancy machines—just toss it in and let the heat do the work

Vanilla-Friendly Design – Feels right at home in any Minecraft world

Future Plans – Batter crafting, pancake varieties, and breakfast combos are on the horizon
